description: We're Team Lumix — Matvey Meshkov and Ulyana Plukhina. We built Sol by Sol, a free 3D web app that opens Mars to everyone using real NASA data: HiRISE terrain, THEMIS thermal maps, and Perseverance's real path, samples and photos. We love space, maps and making science something you can explore with your own hands. Always happy to connect with people into planetary science, 3D graphics and design.
